definitions.full: H2304. chedvah חֶדְוָה noun feminine (late) joy (Aramaic חדוא ). — ׳ח 1Chr 16:27 (in the sanctuary); י ׳חֶדְוַת Neh 8:10 (|| אַלתֵּֿעָצֵ֑בוּ ). חֶדְוָה noun feminine joy ( ᵑ7 Syriac; see Biblical Hebrew II. חדה ); — absolute ׳בְּח Ezra 6:16 with joy .
